name: transition
description: The transition from picture A to picture B, worked out step by step (routes/data/refiner-transition.txt)

connection.description: link: an element of A a viewer would recognise as becoming an element of B; device: no such link, so a crafted transition device.

device.description: With device: which one (e.g. painted over, page turn, weather passing). With link: empty.

link_a.description: With link: the element or region of A the change starts from, and where it sits. With device: where the device starts.

link_b.description: With link: what it becomes in B, and where. With device: what of B appears first, and where.

motion.description: How it gets there: plain movement with a direction.

rest.description: What the rest of the frame does meanwhile.

idea.description: The connection and the manner, in a few words.

full_prompt.description: Two or three sentences for the video model, in time order, built from the fields above.
